subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this combined issue remain the umbrella, or should maintainers split it between a structured Control UI/Gateway reply metadata contract and the durable final-fallback delivery contract?
rationale: The remaining work is real, but the correct ownership boundary spans UI request schema, agent runtime metadata, and channel delivery semantics, and an open conflicting PR covers only part of the reply-metadata direction.

options.title: Split Across Existing Work
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 or a maintainer replacement for structured reply metadata, keep final-fallback semantics in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561, and close this issue only after both halves are clearly tracked.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as the cross-surface coordination tracker until one maintainer-approved design covers both reply metadata and no-output UX.

options.title: Defer Structured Metadata
options.body: Treat current Markdown quote behavior as enough for Control UI for now and keep only the final-fallback contract active.

recommendation.title: Split Across Existing Work
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 or a maintainer replacement for structured reply metadata, keep final-fallback semantics in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561, and close this issue only after both halves are clearly tracked.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main blame and recent refactor history touch the UI send path, protocol schema, and runtime-context boundary that need coordination.
